name: Hellbound
source: A young man whose mother vanished under mysterious circumstances eight years ago meets humiliating, though quick death only to wake up in Hell being told his soul now belongs to a demon. Facing a second death that threatens to wipe his existence from the history books, he has no choice but to ally himself with a homicidal daughter of Lilith and a shapeshifting Rakshasa who’s come to deliver him to her mistress. He’ll have to find out what happened to his mother, why he’s here, and most of all, decide whether he wants to accept or fight the powers that be in this afterlife.
translation: 一个年轻人的母亲在八年前神秘失踪，他虽然很快就死了，但在地狱中醒来时却被告知他的灵魂现在属于恶魔。面对第二次死亡，他的存在可能会从历史书中消失，他别无选择，只能与莉莉丝的杀人女儿和前来把他交给情妇的变形罗刹结盟。他必须查明他的母亲发生了什么事，他为什么在这里，最重要的是，决定他是否愿意接受或对抗来世的力量。
